title: Mara and the Cover
author: B. M. Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
